faq.domanda: How much does it cost to add graphics or wrap a vehicle in Locarno?
faq.risposta: The cost depends on the size of the vehicle, the type of work (partial or full) and the materials chosen. Get in touch for a personalised, free quote within 24/48h.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to add graphics to a vehicle?
faq.risposta: Generally from 1 to 6 working days, depending on the complexity of the project and the surface to be covered. We set the timeline together right at the quote stage.

faq.domanda: In which areas will my branded vehicle be seen?
faq.risposta: Wherever you go. Beyond the centre of Locarno, your vehicle travels and gets noticed throughout the Locarno area, from Ascona to Muralto, Minusio and Losone, all the way across the rest of Ticino: the advertising follows you on every road you travel.

faq.domanda: Do you work throughout Locarno and the rest of the canton?
faq.risposta: Yes. We serve the whole of Locarno, from the centre to the neighbourhoods, and every municipality in Ticino, wherever your business is based. The service isn't tied to a specific area: we follow you and your vehicle where you work.

faq.domanda: Do you also do full wraps to change the colour of a car?
faq.risposta: Yes. As well as advertising graphics, we do complete car wrapping to change the colour or finish (gloss, matte or satin) of private and company cars, using removable films that protect the original paintwork.

faq.domanda: Is it possible to add graphics to just one part of the vehicle, such as the doors or bonnet?
faq.risposta: Absolutely. We create both partial decorations (doors, bonnet, rear window) and full wraps, based on the visual impact you want to achieve and your budget.

faq.domanda: Can I see a preview before printing?
faq.risposta: Yes. Before printing we send a graphic draft of the project for your approval, so you can assess the look and readability on the vehicle before it's produced. The draft is usually available after a deposit has been paid.

faq.domanda: Do I need to wash the vehicle before application?
faq.risposta: Yes. The vehicle must be clean and free of waxes or residues that could compromise how the films adhere. Otherwise, cleaning will be charged separately.
